## testing_mode: RED

## Story DD Coverage
- DD1: Create contract doc with documented syntax, emit/consume sites, escape rules, lifecycle, and pre-S5-historical-specs scope decision
- DD2: Establishes canonical path `plugins/dso/docs/contracts/inferred-source-marker.md` for downstream stories S2/S5/S6 to reference (verification of those references is deferred to those stories)

## Dependency
Task 7c7d-bd80 must be complete first (test section written and RED before implementation).

## File to Create
`plugins/dso/docs/contracts/inferred-source-marker.md`

## Required Content
The file must conform to check-contract-schemas.sh validation rules (universal):
- Level-1 heading: `# Contract: Inferred-Source Marker`
- `## Purpose` section with non-empty content
- Do NOT include `## Signal Name` or `## Signal Format` sections (this is a structural marker, not a signal — the signal-specific schema rule would incorrectly require `### Canonical parsing prefix`)

Required sections and content:
- `## Purpose`: explain the <<inferred:source-name>> marker convention and why it exists
- `## Marker Syntax`: `<<inferred:source-name>>` where source-name is a short identifier
- `## Emit Site`: orchestrator wraps inferred input source mentions in Approach/Context narrative sections at spec-drafting time (Phase 2 Step 2 of brainstorm)
- `## Consume Sites`: (a) approval-gate.md renderer converts marker to bold; (b) gap-analysis scan preserves marker unchanged; (c) SC Gap Check passes through unchanged
- `## Escape Rules`: if source-name contains `>>`, escape as `\>\>` to prevent premature marker termination
- `## Lifecycle`: emitted at draft time (Phase 2), preserved through gap-analysis, consumed/rendered at approval gate, remains in final spec text as bold after approval
- `## Scope Decisions`: pre-S5 historical specs are left unmarked — no backfill; marker emission in non-brainstorm skills is out of epic scope

## After Implementation
Confirm structural test passes GREEN:
`bash tests/docs/test-inferred-source-marker-contract.sh 2>&1 | grep "FAIL"` → expect ZERO output

Remove the RED marker from .test-index (keep the base entry):
Change: `plugins/dso/docs/contracts/inferred-source-marker.md:tests/docs/test-inferred-source-marker-contract.sh [test_inferred_source_marker_contract]`
To: `plugins/dso/docs/contracts/inferred-source-marker.md:tests/docs/test-inferred-source-marker-contract.sh`

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] File exists
  Verify: test -f plugins/dso/docs/contracts/inferred-source-marker.md
- [ ] Level-1 heading starts with "# Contract:"
  Verify: grep -q '^# Contract:' plugins/dso/docs/contracts/inferred-source-marker.md
- [ ] Purpose section present
  Verify: grep -q '^## Purpose' plugins/dso/docs/contracts/inferred-source-marker.md
- [ ] Marker syntax documented
  Verify: grep -q '<<inferred:' plugins/dso/docs/contracts/inferred-source-marker.md
- [ ] check-contract-schemas.sh passes for new contract
  Verify: bash plugins/dso/scripts/check-contract-schemas.sh plugins/dso/docs/contracts/inferred-source-marker.md
- [ ] Structural test passes GREEN
  Verify: bash tests/docs/test-inferred-source-marker-contract.sh 2>&1 | grep "FAIL" | grep -c "." | grep -qE "^0$"
- [ ] RED marker removed from .test-index
  Verify: ! grep -q '\[test_inferred_source_marker_contract\]' .test-index
- [ ] Base .test-index entry still present (entry survives marker removal)
  Verify: grep -q 'inferred-source-marker\.md.*test-inferred-source-marker-contract\.sh' .test-index

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet->opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
